MARINE AND FISHERIES TECHNOLOGY — TERMLY EXAM #9
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: MARINE AND FISHERIES TECHNOLOGY
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Paper burning to ash
   B. Milk souring
   C. Iron rusting
   D. Ice melting to water

2. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Fish Pond? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Fish Pond.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Fish Pond.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Fish Pond.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Fish Pond.

3. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water removes heat too quickly
   B. Petrol fires have no fuel
   C. Water always increases oxygen
   D. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely

4. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Fish Morphology and Anatomy? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Fish Morphology and Anatomy.

6. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Glucose and oxygen

   C. Nitrogen gas only
   D. Only carbon dioxide

   A. Burning crop residue every week
   B. Removing all vegetation
   C. Overgrazing continuously
   D. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Fish morphology and anatomy 2.0 Aquaculture 2.1 Fundamentals of Aquaculture 2.2 ? (1 mark)

   B. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   C. A compound can be separated by filtering only
